_comment: BloodPressureLog (utility shell) screenshot capture - real-use states, never Settings/paywall/onboarding. _setup_taps seeds ~100 readings over 60 days (morning higher than evening, slow downward drift, a few tags/notes), Pro + ad-free (no banner / lock overlays) through window.shellLoadState and defines bpSet(), which sets theme/accent/form values/range and navigates with UI.tab. Phone 7 + tablet_7 2 + tablet_10 2 = 11 distinct states; headlines in metadata/screenshot_headlines*.json describe exactly these screens.
_readiness_expr: typeof UI !== 'undefined' && typeof window.shellLoadState === 'function' && typeof TOOL !== 'undefined' && typeof BP !== 'undefined'
